name: Semantic Shader Augmentation
aliases: dynamic shader generation for semantic mapping
definition: A technique that automatically augments an input GPU shader program with rule-based rendering functionality, replacing static visualization mappings (like transfer functions) with dynamic mappings defined by semantic rules and fuzzy membership functions.
summary: Semantic Shader Augmentation dynamically generates GPU shader code from semantic rules, replacing static mappings with flexible, rule-based visualizations without requiring manual programming.
